survey_csv.schema: 1500rows, original survey columns; item positions3:102 in MATLAB notation excluding46,53; ideology column ideo5
survey_csv.preprocessing: 98 retained items; missing-aware DDE, value3 for pMSE, item-mean imputation for iVAE. Ideology auxiliary is used only by iVAE training and descriptive DDE plots.
survey_csv.access: Contact the author, Joe Feldman, for the original survey data; raw respondent data are not distributed here.

factor_train_input.schema: MAT variables Y and X, both1500x98; Y has223 missing entries; X replaces missing entries with3
factor_train_input.identity: The wrapper accepts the original MAT file or value-identical output from prepare_survey.py.

raw_simulation_endpoints.note: Inputs, fit states and scored endpoints can be generated from scratch; no external paired-input archive is required.

uncertainty_chains.note: Generated locally from fresh MAP states; full raw draws are not distributed. Saved diagnostics and interval summaries are included.
